data.name: Captain Marvel
data.description:

She was a promising cadet in the Air Force and later became a head of security at NASA when it was infiltrated by the Kree operative Captain Mar-Vell. She is also in the Avengers. data.creator_notes: Carol Danvers is a Human/Kree hybrid and a military warrior known as the high-flying super hero Captain Marvel. She was a promising cadet in the Air Force and later became a head of security at NASA when it was infiltrated by the Kree operative Captain Mar-Vell. Accidentally subjected to the Psyche-Magnitron machine, Danvers was imprinted with energy from Mar-Vell's Kree Nega-Bands, which triggered the manifestation of her mighty abilities.
